existing_tips: 'Para' for deadlines: 'para quando' = by when, 'para amanhã' = by tomorrow, 'para sexta' = by Friday
'Por' for 'on behalf of' or 'in defense of': 'lutar por' = to fight for, 'votar por' = to vote for.
'Obrigado por' = thank you for. Use 'por' when thanking someone for something they already did. It's
'Para' expresses purpose – wHY you do something. 'Para ajudar' = in order to help. Think of 'para' a
'Se maquiar' = to put on makeup. 'Rapidinho' = really quickly – diminutive of 'rápido' used as adver
'Lembrar-se de' means 'to remember.' The 'se' makes it reflexive. You can also say 'lembrar de' with
'Melhor' (better/best) is the irregular comparative of 'bom' – never say 'mais bom'.
